description_en: Creates a new EIAM account in a specified organization
description_zh: 调用CreateUser接口在指定组织下，创建新的EIAM的账户资源
kebab_example: aliyun eiam-developerapi create-user --authorization Bearer_AT8csE2seYxxxxxij --instance-id idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --application-id app_mkv7rgt4d7i4u7zqtzev2mxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateUser

parameters.help_en:
The authentication information.
Format: `Bearer ${access_token}`.
Example: `Bearer ATxxxx`
parameters.help_zh:
认证信息。
格式：Bearer ${access_token}。
示例：Bearer ATxxxx
parameters.name: authorization

fields.help_en: The name of the custom field. You can view the field's data type and value range in the IDaaS console
fields.help_zh: 扩展字段标识。类型和值域可通过控制台查看对应扩展字段值的详细信息
fields.name: field_name

fields.help_en: The value of the custom field
fields.name: field_value

parameters.help_en: A list of custom fields for the account
parameters.name: custom_fields

parameters.help_en: The account description. The maximum length is 256 characters
parameters.help_zh: 账户描述，长度限制最长为256字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The display name. The maximum length is 128 characters
parameters.help_zh: 账户展示名。长度限制最长为128字符
parameters.name: display_name

parameters.help_en: The email address. The local-part of the address can contain uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, periods (`.`), underscores (`_`), and hyphens (`-`). The maximum length is 128 characters
parameters.help_zh: 邮箱，邮箱前缀可包含大写英文字母、小写英文字母、数字、点、下划线或中划线，长度限制最长为128字符
parameters.name: email

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the email is verified. This parameter is required if `email` is set. Typically, set this to `true`
parameters.help_zh: 邮箱是否验证，邮箱若设置此字段必须设置，无特殊业务可直接设置为true
parameters.name: email_verified

parameters.help_en: The account password. For password complexity rules, see the password policy in the IDaaS console
parameters.help_zh: 账户密码，密码规则参考IDaaS控制台密码策略
parameters.name: password

fields.help_en:
The password forced update status. By default, this feature is disabled. Valid values:

`enabled`: Enables the feature.

`disabled`: Disables the feature
fields.help_zh:
强制修改密码状态,默认不启用，取值可选范围：
enabled：开启。
disabled：禁用
fields.name: password_forced_update_status

fields.help_en:
The priority of the password initialization policy. Valid values:

`global`: Uses the instance-level password initialization policy and ignores the custom settings in this request. For more information, see the password initialization policy configuration in the IDaaS console.

`custom`: Uses the custom password initialization policy defined in this request. This includes settings for forced password updates, the initialization type, and notification channels
fields.help_zh:
密码初始化策略优先级，默认不生效，取值可选范围：
global：全局优先，采用实例级别的密码初始化策略，即本次设置的密码初始化策略均无效，参考密码相关策略的密码初始化策略。
custom：自定义优先，以当前定义的密码初始化策略为准，包括是否开启强制改密、密码初始化方式以及通知渠道
fields.name: password_initialization_policy_priority

fields.help_en:
The password initialization type. Valid values:

`random`: A randomly generated password
fields.help_zh:
密码初始化方式，取值可选范围：
random：随机
fields.name: password_initialization_type

fields.help_en:
The user notification channels. Valid values:

`email`: Email

`sms`: SMS
fields.help_zh:
密码通知渠道，取值可选范围：
email：邮件。
sms：短信
fields.name: user_notification_channels

parameters.help_en: The account phone number. It must be 6 to 15 digits long
parameters.help_zh: 账户手机号，格式为6～15位数字
parameters.name: phone_number

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the phone number is verified. This parameter is required if `phoneNumber` is set. Typically, set this to `true`
parameters.help_zh: 手机号是否验证，手机号若设置此字段必须设置，无特殊业务可直接设置为true
parameters.name: phone_number_verified

parameters.help_en: The phone region code. For example, the code for the Chinese mainland is `86`. Do not include a `00` prefix or a plus sign (`+`). This parameter is required if `phoneNumber` is set
parameters.help_zh: 手机地区编号,示例：中国大陆手区号为86，不带 00 或 +, 手机号若设置，此参数必填
parameters.name: phone_region

parameters.help_en: The ID of the primary organizational unit
parameters.name: primary_organizational_unit_id

parameters.help_en: The external user ID, used to associate the account with an external system. The maximum length is 128 characters. If unspecified, it defaults to the account ID
parameters.help_zh: 账户外部ID，用于与外部系统的关联，最大长度限制128字符，若不设置，默认设置为账户ID
parameters.name: user_external_id

parameters.help_en: The username. It can contain letters, digits, and the following special characters: underscore (`_`), period (`.`), at sign (`@`), and hyphen (`-`). The maximum length is 256 characters
parameters.help_zh: 账户名称，可包含英文字母、数字、符号“_” 、“ .”、“@”、“-”，长度最大限制256字符
parameters.name: username

schema.title_en: 调用CreateUser接口在指定组织下，创建新的EIAM的账户资源
schema.title_zh: 调用CreateUser接口在指定组织下，创建新的EIAM的账户资源
